summary: reconcile the plan with A0012: fix the stale collateral it left and record the contract conflicts it cannot repair
owner_direction:
Owner direction (2026-09-20): reconcile the plan with amendment A0012. Three independent read-only sweeps of every PLANNED and APPROVED contract against the amended goals, specifications and architecture found the inconsistencies below. The Owner directs that this layer fix every one of them that lies inside its own write surface, and record every one that does not.

PART 1 - fix these, because this layer can edit them. Each is a sentence that A0012 left asserting something the amended documents no longer say:
(a) todo/README.md: "Phase 9 permits only the signing and broadcast surfaces named in T090-T095" still names the pre-A0012 set, although A0012 added T097 as a phase-9 CLI write surface. It must include T097.
(b) todo/phases/P09-signer-testnet-and-live/README.md, phase prohibitions: the clause "or writes a version the Web write path did not authorize" read literally forbids exactly the reduce-only CLI write that G-PERM-WRITE-01 and CTRL-CLI-001 order the CLI to perform, because a CLI-initiated reduction is a version the Web path did not authorize. Restate it to bar writing into a version store the Web write path does not govern, and to bar any increase in a permission or an exposure.
(c) todo/phases/P06-backtesting-and-strategy/README.md: A0012 added T068 and T069 to the phase and to its purpose text, but not to its exit gate, so the phase can be exited with the registry and the product-level run entry point undelivered although T087 and T088 both depend on them. Add both to the exit gate.
(d) docs/implement/TRACEABILITY.md: the G-EXEC-01 row still reads T070, T081, T090-T095, but T097's reduce-only commands are real executions subject to G-EXEC-01. Also make the delivery-standard list in todo/README.md state the reduce-only CLI path, which G-PERM-WRITE-01 makes a V1 goal.
(e) docs/spec/product/ASSET_ADMISSION.md, ADM-PAIR-004: it carries no Web-only-increase / CLI-reduce-only boundary although PROJECT_GOALS.md makes this file the authority for the testable admission rules and T097 cites it.
(f) docs/spec/security/THREAT_MODEL.md: its risk-changing-request control and evidence owners are still scoped to T084-T086 and T090-T095, although A0012 added a second Web write entry (T073) and a CLI write surface (T097).
(g) Update the plan-structure revision line in todo/README.md.

PART 2 - record these in affected_existing_tasks, because this layer may not edit an existing contract and each one now asserts something a governing document contradicts. Verify each claim against the repository before recording it, and state the stale sentence, the contradicting document and why a reader would be misled:
PLANNED contracts: T096 (its transitive dependency closure of 53 tasks contains none of A0012's six new tasks, so the phase-9 exit gate can be satisfied with no evidence for the new goals, pages or CLI surface); T084 (it states "The P08 web-console tasks are T084-T086" and cites ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2, which now assigns phase-8 web modules to T087 and T088); T071 and T072 (neither carries T073 in its dependencies, and each must not operate a paper run before T073 is approved); T082 (it operates a sustained paper run with T073 absent from its closure, and G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01 bars any paper run before the three Owner authorizations exist); T085 (nothing obliges it to continue T073's versioned write path, although todo/README.md requires that it extend the same path rather than create a second one); T086 (its complete owner journeys exclude the two new console pages and it has no dependency on T087 or T088); T091 (its declared input is an approved strategy intent, while T097 makes CLI-issued reduce, collect and exit intents a second caller class the same pre-execution checks must plan); T101 (it defines its panel as a selection over run manifests but names neither T069, which now owns the only product-level producer of them, nor the registry); T102 (model-backed strategies have no registered identity and no declared route by which a run can be requested under one); T103 (WEB-PAGE-011's training and evaluation runs are now a second run-triggering surface owned by T069 and T087, and its unnamed results view is confusable with the page the specification names as the backtest result and assigns to T088); T104 (it attributes the console range view to a single task while the amendment adds a second range and liquidity view with unstated fee provenance); T068 (it cites T060 for a parameter-schema vocabulary T060 does not define - T065 owns it); T069 (it must state its boundary with T063's "one command reruns a saved manifest", because two commands now re-execute a run and only one carries T069's run-state semantics).
APPROVED contracts, which need the retirement route rather than an edit: T066 (its candidate lock freezes a closed field list that does not include the registry revision that now fixes the candidate's identity and admissible parameters, so the same locked candidate can be judged under a changed registry without becoming a new candidate version); T063 (its manifest enumeration omits the registry-derived strategy identity, and T068 changes the validation behaviour of the artifact T063 owns); T067 (its citation list is a closed set that cannot state the registration obligation, and the delivered guide teaches a free-text notes tag as how a policy is identified - the practice T068 forbids); T064 (its parameter surfaces are not bounded by the registered schema's declared ranges, so a probe outside them is a result that cannot be published as a run).
END OF DIRECTION
